events.name: Penn State Nittany Lions at Northwestern Wildcats

headlines.description: — Caleb Komolafe rushed for a career-high 188 yards and a touchdown, and Northwestern routed Penn State 34-13 on Friday night in the first game at the new Ryan Field.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caleb Komolafe stars as Northwestern rushes past Penn State 34-13 in 1st game at Ryan Field
